assumptions: 'Success rate' means attempt-level success rate: successful attempts divided by all attempts, with each retry counted as a separate attempt. Order-level and technical rates are shown alongside.

facts.text: Overall attempt success rate fell 3.1pp from 90.1% (75,001 successes out of 83,268 attempts) in the 10–16 September baseline to 87.0% (19,822 successes out of 22,790 attempts) during 17–18 September.
The performance drop was heavily concentrated in Kestrel Bank, where success rate fell 11.5pp from 90.0% to 78.5%.

Within Kestrel Bank, card payment methods experienced sharp declines: DEBIT_CARD fell 30.1pp from 86.4% to 56.3%, CREDIT_CARD fell 28.7pp from 88.6% to 59.9%, and CARD_EMI fell 23.9pp from 80.7% to 56.8%, while UPI and NETBANKING remained stable.
For card methods on Kestrel Bank, ACQ_TIMEOUT failures increased by 32.02 per 100 attempts, rising from 0.3 per 100 attempts to 32.3 per 100 attempts (803 failures).
Across the entire platform, ACQ_TIMEOUT rose by 3.49 per 100 attempts from 0.1 to 3.6 per 100 attempts, totaling 815 failures during the period.
A data quality scan across acquirer, issuer, merchant, and attempt datasets identified 0 issues.

response.headline: Overall attempt success rate fell 3.1pp from 90.1% to 87.0% across 17–18 September, driven by a like-for-like drop in card payments on Kestrel Bank due to acquirer timeouts.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Examine Kestrel Bank card gateway response latency metrics, error logs, and downstream switch communications during the outage window.
hypotheses.rationale: Non-card payment methods on Kestrel Bank like UPI and NETBANKING saw steady performance, while DEBIT_CARD, CREDIT_CARD, and CARD_EMI plummeted with ACQ_TIMEOUT jumping to 32.3 per 100 attempts.
hypotheses.text: Kestrel Bank experienced gateway degradation or infrastructure timeout issues specifically affecting its card processing pipelines on 17–18 September.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: Kestrel Bank experienced gateway degradation or infrastructure timeout issues specifically affecting its card processing pipelines on 17–18 September.
recommendations.rationale: ACQ_TIMEOUT accounted for 32.3 failures per 100 card attempts on Kestrel Bank during 17–18 September.
recommendations.text: Engage Kestrel Bank's technical account team with incident failure logs showing the 803 ACQ_TIMEOUT card failures to confirm root-cause remediation.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: Within Kestrel Bank, card payment methods experienced sharp declines: DEBIT_CARD fell 30.1pp from 86.4% to 56.3%, CREDIT_CARD fell 28.7pp from 88.6% to 59.9%, and CARD_EMI fell 23.9pp from 80.7% to 56.8%, while UPI and NETBANKING remained stable.
recommendations.rationale: Card success rates on Kestrel Bank dropped below 60.0%, driving an overall system success rate reduction of 3.1pp.
recommendations.text: Implement automated routing failover rules to route card traffic away from Kestrel Bank when acquirer timeout rates cross defined thresholds.
